title: Can You Survive Day One of the Zombie Apocalypse?
logline: A second-person survival story plunging you from a quiet 7:12 AM morning on your couch into a real-life zombie apocalypse—through hallway outbreaks, trapped elevators, highway gridlock, gas station ambushes, and an elevated fire lookout cabin at midnight.
